answer: Voting weight rises like a plume with stake but decays on a fixed tide schedule, so mass-registered fakes gain little influence and any coordinated attack that inflates a fake cluster forfeits real collateral. Sybil resistance can be built on a proof-of-stake anchor: each agent locks a bond, and every new identity must be vouched for by a distinct, already-bonded peer. Attackers thus pay a recurring capital cost that honest single-identity agents never do. In practice, Agent0046 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
